svg.title: A thoughtful message for Valentine’s Day

text.tspan: A handmade greeting creates a personal message.
A thoughtful message for Valentine’s Day
When we send a thoughtful greeting, a little care can make the experience better. Planning and
thinking about other people both help.
First, a specific message expresses care more clearly than a grand phrase. For example, we
thank a friend for a particular act of kindness. This is a small thing that makes the day easier.
Second, respecting the recipient makes a greeting considerate. For example, we avoid assuming
that everyone wants a romantic message. We do not need a perfect day to do this well.
We can send a thoughtful greeting more easily when we prepare and notice other people. These
simple steps give us a useful place to start.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the
conclusion. Each body paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the
argument rather than introduce a new proposal.
Explain two ways to send a thoughtful greeting. Which do you like better? Use four short paragraphs: introduction, two
developed points, and conclusion. (Model: One possible outline: say what you want to do; explain the first step; explain a
different second step; say why the two steps help.)
